stories.story_fr: NetApp atteint un chiffre d'affaires annuel record de 6,93 milliards de dollars en FY2026, en hausse de 5% par rapport a FY2025, avec un Q4 a +12% en glissement annuel.
stories.story_en: NetApp reaches a record annual revenue of $6.93 billion in FY2026, up 5% year-over-year, with Q4 growing 12% year-over-year.
stories.signal: CA annuel record FY2026 : +5% YoY, Q4 +12% YoY
stories.quote: net revenues were a record $1.948 billion for the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026, an increase of 12% year-over-year

stories.story_fr: Les solutions All-Flash Array de NetApp atteignent un record de 1,2 milliard de dollars au Q4 FY2026 (+18% YoY), portant le run rate annualise a 4,2 milliards de dollars.
stories.story_en: NetApp's All-Flash Array solutions reach a record $1.2 billion in Q4 FY2026 (+18% YoY), bringing the annualized run rate to $4.2 billion.
stories.signal: AFA Q4 record : 1,2 Md$ (+18% YoY), run rate 4,2 Md$
stories.quote: all-flash array revenue was a record $1.2 billion for the fourth quarter...an increase of 18% year-over-year

stories.story_fr: NetApp genere un flux de tresorerie disponible record de 1,87 milliard de dollars en FY2026, en hausse de 40% par rapport a FY2025, confirmant une forte conversion du benefice en cash.
stories.story_en: NetApp generates a record free cash flow of $1.87 billion in FY2026, up 40% year-over-year, confirming strong profit-to-cash conversion.

stories.story_fr: Les revenus cloud de NetApp atteignent 182 millions de dollars au Q4 FY2026 (+11% YoY), avec le premier parti et marketplace en croissance de 27% YoY au Q3 FY2026.
stories.story_en: NetApp's cloud revenues reach $182 million in Q4 FY2026 (+11% YoY), with first-party and marketplace growing 27% YoY in Q3 FY2026.
stories.quote: public cloud revenue was $182 million for the fourth quarter...an increase of 11% year-over-year

stories.story_fr: NetApp lance l'AI Data Engine, une plateforme de donnees IA de bout en bout co-developpee avec NVIDIA, positionnant la societe sur le marche de l'infrastructure IA d'entreprise.
stories.story_en: NetApp launches the AI Data Engine, an end-to-end AI data platform co-engineered with NVIDIA, positioning the company in the enterprise AI infrastructure market.
stories.signal: Lancement AI Data Engine avec NVIDIA (Q4 FY26)
stories.quote: launched the AI Data Engine, an end-to-end AI data platform co-engineered with NVIDIA

stories.story_fr: NetApp prevoit un chiffre d'affaires FY2027 entre 7,33 et 7,58 milliards de dollars, soit une croissance de 6 a 9% par rapport au record FY2026 de 6,93 milliards de dollars.
stories.story_en: NetApp guides FY2027 revenue of $7.33-$7.58 billion, representing 6-9% growth over the FY2026 record of $6.93 billion.
stories.quote: Net revenues are expected to be in the range of: $7.325 billion - $7.575 billion
